title: Draft: Qt: Packet Diagram: Descend into FT_NONE items
description:
Most FT_NONE items are containers, and it's often more useful to see
the members that they contain.

Fix #20943

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: This can lead to gaps when a FT_NONE has child items that don't fill in all the bytes. Not sure if it's worth trying to figure out a way around it.
Another option would be to display FT_PROTOCOL (and also some FT_NONE?) as new top level items as "PDUs" or similar.
@geraldcombs, what do you think about this approach? I think this looks more useful for most protocols, but I'm not sure if it needs more tweaks.
